messages:
nora: Quick heads-up — quark13b (int4) exhibit intermittent OOMs when serving long multi-turn chats on dedicated nodes. Happens more on routes with high token caps.

zane: repro steps?

nora: repro I ran: `redwoodctl perf run --model quark13b --quant int4 --batch 6 --concurrency 120 --max_new_tokens 1500`
Logs: slab.free_percent drifts down over time, then OOM at ~10-12k total tokens across concurrent sessions. heap snapshots show many small free chunks (128/256B).

jo: sounds like fragmentation + pinned KV. Any KV leak per session?

nora: KV per-session grows as expected, but compactor only coalesces when >10% fragmentation. Pinned objects block merges.

zane: quick mitigation ideas: lower default max_new_tokens, add aggressive compaction window for this model, and cap per-session KV entries. Also consider switching to a slower int4 kernel with bias-corr to recover quality.

nora: tested patch: `compact_interval=45s`, `fragmentation_threshold=0.08`, `per_session_kv_cap=6000`, `prefetch_tokens=16`. Ran 1h soak with 300 sticky sessions — no OOMs, p95 +15ms.

jo: great. quality hit?

nora: baseline int4 -> MMLU -2.6. With kernel+bias_corr -> -0.6. Latency +9%.

infra-bot: Canary plan: deploying canary config to pool `quark-13b-int4-canary` at 3165012500 by zane.

zane: rollout checklist:
1) 12h soak on canary (zane)
2) regression eval MMLU + convQA (nora)
3) load test 500 concurrent sticky sessions (jo)
4) add alerts: `gpu.slab.free_percent < 15%`, `kv.per_session_bytes > 6MB` (ops)

ops: I'll add the alerts and a runbook entry. Emergency rollback commands: `redwoodctl config set --model quark13b --per_session_kv_cap 0` and `redwoodctl route set --model quark13b --fallback int8 --threshold 0.9`.

nora: OK I'll start eval tomorrow morning. If green, we'll flip defaults: max_new_tokens=512, prefetch_tokens=16, enable bias_corr on int4.

zane: document the perf/regression numbers in the model onboarding PR.

jo: thanks — sounds like a solid plan :thumbsup:
